name: Artificial intelligence
description: Follow Artificial intelligence, a tracked topic, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02927-1 Extensive cellular integration might provide platform for in vivo testing of new therapies — plus, the AI tool that turns papers into ‘virtual corresponding authors’.

changes.title: Who gets credit in the AI era? OpenAI maths bombshell sparks debate
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02910-w Controversy around OpenAI’s claim to have solved the Navier–Stokes problem highlights how researchers could be inadvertently sharing — and absorbing— ideas through chatbots.

changes.title: When AI goes rogue, its human overseers may be to blame
changes.summary: When AI agents hack real systems, the bigger issue may be the human choices that gave them access, autonomy and too few safeguards.

changes.title: AI is feared globally as the destroyer of jobs
changes.summary: In 34 of the 37 surveyed countries, people are more likely to believe AI will lead to job losses over the next 20 years. | Image: Pew Pew Research has published a new global survey that sheds light on how people view AI, including its impact on jobs, life in general, and income inequality. The survey questioned 42,151.

changes.title: Gaza documentary praised at Venice sparks fury in Israel
changes.summary: The documentary "NAZA" alleges the IDF used AI software to knowingly kill civilians in Gaza. It won a 25-minute standing ovation at Venice — but Israeli leaders are calling it treason. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports.

changes.title: As campaign season gears up, AI-generated ads are everywhere
changes.summary: Data suggests many candidates are embracing AI this year to boost their image and portray their opponents unfavorably. But whether it will turn out voters remains unclear. (Image credit: AI-generated campaign ads).

changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded
changes.summary: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

changes.title: The sexy AI-powered dating app scams are here
changes.summary: Security researcher Matthew "Zigula" Gore-Kormanik was analyzing a fraudulent dating app called Dora when he got a pop-up message saying he was receiving a call from Jennifer. According to her bio, she's a 41-year-old Sagittarius with red hair, blue eyes, and piercings. She likes music, horror movies, nightlife, and sp.

changes.title: Tech stock selloff after AI leaders call for slowdown in development
changes.summary: Calls for a slowdown in AI development sparked a global selloff in tech stocks on Monday. Jessica Inskip, the director of investor research at StockBrokers.com, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

changes.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
changes.summary: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI. (Image credit: Sanders credit: Sarah Rice/Getty Images and Bannon credit: Kayla Bartkowski/Getty Images).
